submitted.rationale: EQE peaked on the Pb-rich side of the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore composition (Sb 0.5). Measured values: Sb 0.28 gave 0.028%, 0.353 gave 0.069%, 0.383 gave 0.056%, 0.513 gave 0.024% and 0.659 gave 0.001%. Index 3 (Sb 0.353) is the highest and sits at a local maximum bracketed by lower values on both sides.
